verdict.rationale: Mastra documents routing webhook or polling events from external resources into agent threads as notification signals, which is event-driven triggering of agent activity. Workflows add branching logic that could act on those events. Recurring schedules are time-based, not event-based, so they don't count here, and one user found branching clunky for rules-based steps. missing for 10: an explicit rule/condition definition model for event-to-action triggers, documentation of how events map to concrete actions (e.g., starting a workflow), and independent hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Subscribe agent threads to external resources and route webhook or polling events into notification signals.
Mastra workflows use an intuitive syntax for control flow including .then(), .branch() and .parallel() methods.
